verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer docs list official SDKs for Swift, .NET, Java, JavaScript, Objective-C and Python. The GitHub repos confirm the official JavaScript SDK (with a usage example and supported runtimes) and the official Python SDK. Supporting docs cover OAuth and the Files API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and no evidence of AI/agent-specific SDK affordances (no OpenAPI spec found).
